topic: Key tips to providing a psychologically safe learning environment in the clinical setting

sources.title: Key tips to providing a psychologically safe learning environment in the clinical setting
sources.authors: Hardie P, O'Donovan R, Jarvis S, Redmond C.

findings.finding: Psychological safety allows learners to take interpersonal risks like asking questions or sharing ideas without fear.
findings.quote: Psychological safety refers to a student's belief as to whether or not it is safe for them to take interpersonal risks, such as asking questions, sharing an idea for improvement

findings.finding: Being an accessible and approachable teacher is essential for cultivating a safe learning space.
findings.quote: A crucial attribute to cultivating a psychologically safe environment involves being an accessible and approachable preceptor.

principle: Creating a psychologically safe environment where learners feel empowered and included fosters better collaboration and more effective learning.
for_the_teacher: Explicitly invite the learner to ask questions or share their thoughts at the start of the session to encourage interpersonal risk-taking.
Maintain an approachable demeanor throughout the lesson to ensure the learner feels comfortable expressing confusion or difficulty.
